<js>
java.longToast("多刷新两次，如果失败可能网址失效了，可查看源注释重新获取。");
(function() {
    try {
        // 第一步：获取HTML
        var baseUrl = "https://ztopaq7zrz.hq555.icu:1678";
        var html = java.connect(baseUrl + "/so").getBody();

        if (html.match(/easy_slider_html/) || html.match(/安全验证/)) {
            cookie.removeCookie(source.bookSourceUrl);

            java.startBrowserAwait(baseUrl, '人机验证');
            html = java.connect(baseUrl + "/so").getBody();
        };

        if (!html) return '';

        // 第二步：解析HTML
        var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);

        // 第三步：获取标题元素
        var titles = doc.select('.layui-tab-item-title');
        // java.log("找到标题数量: " + titles.size());

        if (titles.size() < 4) {
            //  java.log("标题数量不足4个");
            return '';
        }

        // 第四步：初始化结果数组
        var results = [];

        // 获取小说区域
        var fictionTitle = titles.get(1);
        var comicTitle = titles.get(2);
        var endTitle = titles.get(3);

        //  java.log("小说标题: " + fictionTitle.text());
        // java.log("漫画标题: " + comicTitle.text());
        // java.log("结束标题: " + endTitle.text());

        // 1. 添加"小说"大类
        results.push({
            "title": "小说",
            "url": "",
            "style": {
                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1
            }
        });

        // 提取小说子分类
        // java.log("\n=== 开始提取小说子分类 ===");
        var currentElement = fictionTitle.nextElementSibling();
        var fictionCount = 0;

        while (currentElement && !currentElement.equals(comicTitle)) {
            if (currentElement.hasClass('layui-tab-item-tagContainer')) {
                //   java.log("找到小说tagContainer");

                var links = currentElement.select('a');
                //   java.log("小说容器中有" + links.size() + "个链接");

                for (var i = 0; i < links.size(); i++) {
                    var link = links.get(i);

                    // 提取名称
                    var span = link.selectFirst('span.layui-tab-item-tagContainer-tag');
                    var name = '';
                    if (span) {
                        name = span.text().trim();
                    } else {
                        name = link.text().trim();
                    }

                    // 提取链接（保持原始相对或绝对路径）
                    var href = link.attr('href');

                    if (name && href) {
                        // 仅确保链接包含分页参数，不处理相对链接转换
                        if (!href.includes("{{page}}")) {
                            href = href + "/{{page}}";
                        }

                        results.push({
                            "title": name,
                            "url": href,
                            "style": {
                                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25
                            }
                        });
                        fictionCount++;
                        //   java.log("添加小说子分类: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }

            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }

        //  java.log("小说子分类数量: " + fictionCount);

        // 2. 添加"漫画"大类
        results.push({
            "title": "漫画",
            "url": "",
            "style": {
                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1
            }
        });

        // 提取漫画子分类
        //   java.log("\n=== 开始提取漫画子分类 ===");
        currentElement = comicTitle.nextElementSibling();
        var comicCount = 0;

        while (currentElement && !currentElement.equals(endTitle)) {
            if (currentElement.hasClass('layui-tab-item-tagContainer')) {
                //   java.log("找到漫画tagContainer");

                var links = currentElement.select('a');
                //   java.log("漫画容器中有" + links.size() + "个链接");

                for (var i = 0; i < links.size(); i++) {
                    var link = links.get(i);

                    // 提取名称
                    var span = link.selectFirst('span.layui-tab-item-tagContainer-tag');
                    var name = '';
                    if (span) {
                        name = span.text().trim();
                    } else {
                        name = link.text().trim();
                    }

                    // 提取链接（保持原始相对或绝对路径）
                    var href = link.attr('href');

                    if (name && href) {
                        // 仅确保链接包含分页参数，不处理相对链接转换
                        if (!href.includes("{{page}}")) {
                            href = href + "/{{page}}";
                        }

                        results.push({
                            "title": name,
                            "url": href,
                            "style": {
                                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25
                            }
                        });
                        comicCount++;
                        //   java.log("添加漫画子分类: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }

            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }

        //   java.log("漫画子分类数量: " + comicCount);

        // 第五步：返回JSON
        // java.log("\n最终生成的发现地址规则:");
        // java.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
        return JSON.stringify(results);
    } catch (e) {
        return "" + e;
    }
})();
</js>

                        // 仅确保链接包含分页参数，不处理相对链接转换
                        if (!href.includes("{{page}}")) {
                            href = href + "/{{page}}";
                        }

                        results.push({
                            "title": name,
                            "url": href,
                            "style": {
                                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25
                            }
                        });
                        fictionCount++;
                        //   java.log("添加小说子分类: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }

            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }

        //  java.log("小说子分类数量: " + fictionCount);

        // 2. 添加"漫画"大类
        results.push({
            "title": "漫画",
            "url": "",
            "style": {
                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1
            }
        });

        // 提取漫画子分类
        //   java.log("\n=== 开始提取漫画子分类 ===");
        currentElement = comicTitle.nextElementSibling();
        var comicCount = 0;

        while (currentElement && !currentElement.equals(endTitle)) {
            if (currentElement.hasClass('layui-tab-item-tagContainer')) {
                //   java.log("找到漫画tagContainer");

                var links = currentElement.select('a');
                //   java.log("漫画容器中有" + links.size() + "个链接");

                for (var i = 0; i < links.size(); i++) {
                    var link = links.get(i);

                    // 提取名称
                    var span = link.selectFirst('span.layui-tab-item-tagContainer-tag');
                    var name = '';
                    if (span) {
                        name = span.text().trim();
                    } else {
                        name = link.text().trim();
                    }

                    // 提取链接（保持原始相对或绝对路径）
                    var href = link.attr('href');

                    if (name && href) {
                        // 仅确保链接包含分页参数，不处理相对链接转换
                        if (!href.includes("{{page}}")) {
                            href = href + "/{{page}}";
                        }

                        results.push({
                            "title": name,
                            "url": href,
                            "style": {
                                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25
                            }
                        });
                        comicCount++;
                        //   java.log("添加漫画子分类: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }

            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }

        //   java.log("漫画子分类数量: " + comicCount);

        // 第五步：返回JSON
        // java.log("\n最终生成的发现地址规则:");
        // java.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
        return JSON.stringify(results);
    } catch (e) {
        return "" + e;
    }
})();
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
loadDocType="{{@@body@data-doctype}}";
loadType="{{@@body@data-randomtype}}";
sid=baseUrl.match(/(\d+).html/)[1];
url=baseUrl.replace(/\d+.html/,'')

var section = {
    loadDocType: loadDocType,
    loadType: loadType,
    sid:sid,
    content: {
        childNode: [],
        
        init: function(c){
            this.body=c
            if (section.loadType == 'normal') {
      this.load(String(java.base64Decode(java.getString('//*[@name="client"]/@content'))))
            } else if (section.loadType == 'substep') {
                var d = 'r' + section.sid;
                var f = false;
                if (section.loadDocType == 'xml') {
                    d += '.xml'
                } else if (section.loadDocType == 'json') {
                    d += '.json';
                    f = true
                } else {
                    return false
                };        
             cookie="PHPSESSID="+java.get(baseUrl,{}).cookie("PHPSESSID");
            token= java.get(url+d,{"X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest","referer":baseUrl,"cookie":String(cookie)}).header("token")                
                	this.load(token)      	
            } else {
                return false
            };               
        },
        load: function(a) {         
            a = String(java.base64Decode(a)).split(/[A-Z]+%/);      
            var b = 0,
            start = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < this.body.length; i++) {
                if (String(this.body[i]).match(/h2/i)) {
                    start = i + 1
                };
                if (String(this.body[i]).match(/div/i)&& this.body[i].attr("class") != 'chapter') {
                    break
                }
            };
          
            for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                if (a[i] < 5) {
                    this.childNode[a[i]] = this.body[i + start];
                      b++
                } else {
                    this.childNode[a[i] - b] = this.body[i + start]                 
                }
            };
  }
}
}
section.content.init(java.getElement("@@id.content@children!0").toArray());
section.content.childNode.join("")
</js>
tag.div@ownText

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let data=JSON.parse(result).data
let chapterList=[]
for(var volume of data){
	chapterList.push({
		name:volume.volume_name,
		isVolume:true,
		info:volume.volume_desc
		})
		for(var chapter of volume.chapter_list){
			var isVip=chapter.chapter_ispay==0?"":"💰"
			var time=java.timeFormat(chapter.chapter_time*1000)
			chapterList.push({
				name:isVip+chapter.chapter_name,
				isVolume:false,
				info:`更新时间:`+time+` 字数:${chapter.chapter_number}`,
				url:`/api/readWithEncrypt?chapter_id=${chapter.chapter_id}&nid=${chapter.chapter_nid}&preload=0`
				})
			}
	}
chapterList
</js>

//注意：一般网站默认首页(即baseUrl)有搜索框，否则请填入搜索页面地址
var url = baseUrl;
if (!baseUrl.match(/^https?:/i)) {
    java.log('\n\n\n\n‼️请填入正确的Url‼️\n\n\n\n');
}
var html = java.ajax(url + ",{'webView': true}");
//java.log(html);
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var form = doc.select('form[action]:not([name~=login]):not([class~=login]):not([id~=login])')[0];
//java.log(form);
var method = form.attr('method');
var action = form.attr('action');
var charset = doc.select('head>meta[charset]').attr('charset');
if (charset == '')
{
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, 
    '$1');
}
//java.log(method);
//java.log(action);
//java.log(charset);
//桌面版UA
var uaw = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36";
//手机版UA
var uam = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 7.0; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/48.0.2564.116 Mobile Safari/537.36 T7/10.3 SearchCraft/2.6.2 (baiduboxapp; P1 7.0)";
var headers = {
    //请自行选择UA，↓↓↓填入此处
    "User-Agent" : uaw, "Referer" : String(baseUrl)
};
url = baseUrl.replace(/([^\/])$/i, '$1/') + String(action).replace(/^\//, '');
var body = '';
var option = {};
var sk = form.select('input[name][type="text"],input[name][class="text"]').attr('name');
//java.log(sk);
var es = form.select('input[name]:not([type="submit"])');
for (var it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))
{
    option = 
    {
        "charset" : String(charset), "method" : String(method), "body" : String(body), "headers" : headers, 
        "webView" : true 
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
else
{
    //get
    option = {
        "charset" : String(charset), "headers" : headers, "webView" : true 
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
java.log(url);
</js>

<js>
var url = 'https://m.22biqu.com';
var html = java.ajax(url + ",{'webView': true}");
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var form = doc.select('form[action]:not([name~=login]):not([class~=login]):not([id~=login])')[0];
var method = form.attr('method');
var action = form.attr('action');
var charset = doc.select('head>meta[charset]').attr('charset');
if (charset == '') {
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, '$1');
}
var uaw = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36";
var headers = {
    "User-Agent": uaw,
    "Referer": String('https://m.22biqu.com')
};
url = 'https://m.22biqu.com/' + String(action).replace(/^\//, '');
var body = '';
var option = {};
var sk = form.select('input[name][type="text"],input[name][class="text"]').attr('name');
var es = form.select('input[name]:not([type="submit"])');
for (var it in es) {
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    } else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es) {
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
if (method.match(/post/i)) {
    option = {
        "charset": String(charset),
        "method": String(method),
        "body": String(body),
        "headers": headers,
        "webView": true
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
} else {
    option = {
        "charset": String(charset),
        "headers": headers,
        "webView": true
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
url;
</js>
